GAME_CONNECTION_FIX_ERROR:
Ef vinur þinn getur ekki tengst netþjóninum þínum eða þú getur ekki tengst netþjóni vinar þíns. Það er engin önnur lausn en þessi 3 skref.

1. Steam ótengdur hamur (Ekki nota Steam í ótengdum ham)
2. Hvaða VPN forrit sem er (AvastVPN, NordVPN, o.s.frv. / Lokaðu VPN forritinu þínu og reyndu aftur)
3. Vandamál með vírusvarnarforrit (Slökktu á vírusvarnarforritinu þínu og reyndu)

Mikilvæg athugasemd: Báðir aðilar þurfa að athuga þessi skref.
APP_PATREON_PROCESS_SUCCESS: The Supporter Key has been successfully activated. You can now easily play on official servers using the invite code.
APP_PATREON_KEY_REMOVE_SUCCESS: Supporter Key has been successfully removed.
APP_PATREON_SCREEN_INF_TXT:
Supporter Key enables the invite code system, allowing you to play with your friends much more easily without having to use third-party programs like Hamachi.
When you create a server, you can easily start playing by sharing the 6-digit invite code with your friend.
If you don't have a Supporter Key, you'll need to use programs like Hamachi.
